claim: Sanlúcar de Barrameda sits roughly 27 km from El Puerto de Santa María, about a 30-minute drive.
quote: It's 17 miles or 27 km from Sanlucar de Barrameda to El Puerto de Santa Maria ... It takes about 30 minutes to drive between the two cities.

claim: Bodegas Barbadillo, which first bottled manzanilla in 1827, offers tourist tours from a €5 museum visit with one glass to a €20 two-centuries-of-history tour with a three-wine tasting.
quote: The Barbadillo family settled in Sanlucar de Barrameda and bottled Manzanilla for the first time in 1827 ... museum guided tour + tasting of 1 glass of Manzanilla (€5 ... a tasting of 3 emblematic wines (Adults: 20€

claim: Family-owned Bodegas Hidalgo, founded 1792, still makes La Gitana manzanilla and runs central two-hour tours plus specialised sunset (€40) and summer night (€35) tastings.
quote: family-owned 1792-founded Bodegas Hidalgo still produces the famed La Gitana manzanillas ... specialised visits include sunset tastings among the vines (€40) and summer night tours (€35)

claim: Casa Bigote, founded 1951 in the Bajo de Guía fishing quarter at the Guadalquivir's mouth, is famed for its langostinos and seafood with views over Doñana.
quote: Casa Bigote is located in Bajo de Guía at the mouth of the Guadalquivir River with views of Doñana ... founded in 1951 ... renowned for its fresh seafood, particularly the langostinos

claim: Casa Bigote took a temporary closure through the end of March 2026, reopening reservations from 23 March 2026.
quote: Casa Bigote, situated in Bajo de Guía ... announced a temporary closure for vacation until the end of March 2026 ... reservations reopen starting March 23, 2026.

claim: Doñana boat trips aboard the riverboat Real Fernando depart from Bajo de Guía to Poblado de la Plancha in the national park; the round trip runs 3.5 hours costing €30 adults and €20 children.
quote: aboard the riverboat Royal Fernando ... begins in Sanlúcar de Barrameda ... from the location known as Bajo Guía ... The round trip takes 3½ hours and tickets cost 30€ for adults and 20€ for children

claim: The Sanlúcar beach horse races run on two sets of August 2026 dates (Aug 8-10 and Aug 21-23) at evening low tide, are among Europe's oldest equestrian events, and were declared of International Tourist Interest in 1997.
quote: Dates: August 8-10 and August 21-23, 2026 ... the oldest equestrian activities in Spain and one of the oldest ones in Europe ... declared of International Tourist Interest in 1997.
